desc: Streamline your target practice setup with the Stow-N-Go Target Stakes, the Quick Setup Takedown Version. These innovative target stakes are designed for rapid assembly and disassembly, making them perfect for on-the-go shooters. The two-piece design allows the stakes to be compactly taken down to 29 inches for easy transport, while the assembled height reaches an impressive 52 inches. Crafted from durable 1/4-inch solid steel stock, these stakes ensure long-lasting performance. Included are six snap-on Alligator Target holding clips, providing a secure hold for both corrugated and paper targets. Enhance your shooting experience with the convenience and reliability of Stow-N-Go Target Stakes.
